RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT This Residential Lease Agreement (the "Lease") is entered into on June 15, 2026, by and between Cedar Row Properties LLC, an Oregon limited liability company ("Landlord"), and Daniel R. Okafor ("Tenant"). Landlord and Tenant are each a "Party" and together the "Parties". 1. Premises Landlord leases to Tenant the residential unit located at 1427 Alder Street, Unit 3B, Portland, Oregon 97205 (the "Premises"), together with the appliances listed in Schedule A. Landlord shall provide one (1) assigned parking space at no additional charge. The Premises shall be used solely as a private residence for Tenant and Tenant's immediate family. 2. Term The term of this Lease begins on August 1, 2026 and ends on July 31, 2027 (the "Term"). Unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the Term, this Lease shall continue on a month-to-month basis under the same terms and conditions. 3. Rent Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $2,450.00, due in advance on the first (1st) day of each calendar month. Rent shall be paid by electronic transfer to the account designated by Landlord in writing. Rent for any partial month shall be prorated on a daily basis. 4. Security Deposit Upon signing this Lease, Tenant shall deposit $2,450.00 with Landlord as security for the performance of Tenant's obligations. Landlord shall return the deposit, less any lawful deductions itemized in writing, within thirty-one (31) days after Tenant surrenders the Premises. 5. Fees and Charges In addition to rent, Tenant shall pay the following fees when they apply:
ChargeAmountWhen Due
Late fee$75.00Rent unpaid by the 5th
Returned payment$35.00Each occurrence
Lock change$120.00On request
Early terminationOne month's rentOn notice
6. Utilities Tenant shall pay for electricity, internet, and natural gas. Landlord shall pay for water, sewer, and garbage collection. Tenant shall transfer the electricity account into Tenant's name before the start of the Term. 7. Use and Alterations Cedar Row Properties - Residential Lease - Draft 1 Tenant shall keep the Premises clean and in good condition, and shall not make any alterations without Landlord's prior written consent. No animals of any kind are permitted on the Premises. Tenant may not install satellite dishes or exterior antennas on the building. 8. Maintenance and Repairs Landlord shall maintain the roof, structure, plumbing, heating, and electrical systems in good working order. Tenant shall promptly report any defect or damage to Landlord in writing. Tenant shall be responsible for the cost of repairs caused by the negligence of Tenant or Tenant's guests. 9. Entry by Landlord Landlord may enter the Premises to inspect, make repairs, or show the Premises to prospective tenants or buyers, after giving Tenant at least twenty-four (24) hours' notice, except in an emergency. 10. Governing Law This Lease shall be governed by the laws of the State of Oregon. Any dispute arising under this Lease shall be brought in the courts of Multnomah County, Oregon. 11. Entire Agreement This Lease, including Schedule A, is the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions. Any amendment must be in writing and signed by both Parties. Landlord: Cedar Row Properties LLC Signature: Date: Tenant: Daniel R. Okafor Signature: Date: Cedar Row Properties - Residential Lease - Draft 1
